name: data
label: File
help: Look up by the file itself. It is hashed inside Make; only the hash is sent.

name: digest
label: Digest
help: Look up by SHA-256 as base64.

name: counter
label: Counter
help: Optional. Select one specific causal position when the same bytes have been recorded more than once. Without it, the earliest, that is the originating, position is returned.

name: epoch
label: Epoch ID
help: Optional. Qualifies the counter. URL-safe base64.
